data: Is the colour of the cell in the top right corner blue?

The question asks whether the color of the cell in the top right corner is blue. From the analysis of the figure, the top right corner corresponds to bin 10 for layer 1. The color scale at the bottom indicates that lighter shades of red represent higher values, while darker shades of blue represent lower values. The value in the top right corner is 1.000, which is the highest value in the figure. According to the color scale, this value corresponds to a very light shade of red, not blue. Therefore, the color of the cell in the top right corner is not blue.
